entities.name: The Communist Manifesto
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Political pamphlet by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels (1848) declaring that the history of all societies is the history of class struggles. It called on workers of the world to unite and became the foundational text of communist movements.
